xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4841: Phone app: store, Firebase, APNs and directory setup, and first TestFlight and Play builds

plan.title: Phone app: store, Firebase, APNs and directory setup, and first TestFlight and Play builds
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The phone app (apps/mobile) has no store presence: no App Store Connect or Play app, no Firebase project, no APNs key, no release signing or build scripts, Capacitor's default icons, no iOS privacy manifest, and connect.overdeck.ai/healthz reports apns:false and fcm:false, which blocked PAN-4838's real-APNs check and PAN-4839's Live Activity device check and blocks PAN-4840's Android push run.
narratives.Proposal: Lower epic W-REL1 against the current code (PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4841.md). The operator does every console step once from one checklist in apps/mobile/RELEASE.md; secrets reach the agent only through request_secret/secret_wait and go straight into wrangler secret put (no Worker code deploy). The repo gains env-driven Android release signing, a build-android.sh that signs and pins the upload certificate, a build-ios-on-rig.sh that archives and uploads from a console Terminal session on the Mac rig, a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, generated Overdeck icons and splash, the committed google-services.json, and a privacy policy published through an overdeck-landing PR. The first Play internal and TestFlight builds follow, then the PAN-4838 (AC-11) and PAN-4839 (AC-12) device checks are recorded in ACCEPTANCE.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Android push decryption code or its emulator run (PAN-4840).
- User documentation pages such as configuration/phone-app.mdx (PAN-4842).
- App Store or Play production release, store listing text, screenshots, or App Review submission.
- In-app account deletion.
- A Firebase iOS app or GoogleService-Info.plist.
- Any services/connect code change, wrangler deploy, or wrangler rollback.
- Any .github/workflows/ change.
- Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, Codemagic or other CI release automation.
- Reusing MYN's Firebase project mind-your-now or its service account.
- Adding ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption to Info.plist.
- Committing the upload keystore, its password, or any secret value.

autoDecisions.summary: The work agent sets the five push secrets with wrangler secret put; it never runs wrangler deploy.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's 2026-11-04 decision routes secrets to the agent and PAN-4838's comment asks this issue to set them; secret put reuses the deployed code, so 'production Worker deploys stay with the operator' holds. docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md gains this one exception.

autoDecisions.summary: Build numbers are passed on the command line (--build <n>); version name stays 1.0.
autoDecisions.rationale: Nothing is committed per build and the stores refuse reused numbers, so no local counter is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: First store builds do not wait for PAN-4840.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4840 waits for this issue's google-services.json and FCM secret; waiting on its merge would deadlock. A later build ships Android push.

autoDecisions.summary: Privacy policy source lives in apps/mobile/store/privacy-app.html and is published by a PR to eltmon/overdeck-landing at site/privacy/app/index.html.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic names overdeck.ai/privacy/app in the landing repo; keeping the source here lets review see it.

autoDecisions.summary: Replace Capacitor's default icons and splash with generated Overdeck assets (sharp 0.35.4, favicon.svg on #202020).
autoDecisions.rationale: Store builds should not carry another product's logo; sharp is already in the bun store and the PWA uses #202020.

autoDecisions.summary: Add an app-level PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declaring UserDefaults reason CA92.1.
autoDecisions.rationale: OverdeckKeysPlugin.swift uses UserDefaults, a required-reason API that App Store Connect flags without a declaration.

autoDecisions.summary: Export compliance is answered by the operator; ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is not set.
autoDecisions.rationale: The app uses standard end-to-end encryption; this is a legal declaration (NFR-4: no agreements without the operator).

autoDecisions.summary: APNS_TEAM_ID defaults to KUU2VM9GB9 but is still requested; FCM_PROJECT_ID is derived from google-services.json.
autoDecisions.rationale: The team id is the rig's signing team but the operator confirms which team owns the key; deriving the project id avoids a mismatch.

autoDecisions.summary: Store name fallback 'Overdeck Anywhere' if 'Overdeck' is taken; bundle id and display name stay.
autoDecisions.rationale: Store names are unique; the fallback keeps the brand.

autoDecisions.summary: FCM uses a dedicated service account with only Firebase Cloud Messaging API Admin, falling back to the firebase-adminsdk key.
autoDecisions.rationale: Least privilege; the fallback covers consoles that refuse key creation.

items.title: Write the operator checklist in apps/mobile/RELEASE.md and post it on PAN-4841

metadata.acJustification: Five ACs: step count, secrets table, A1 identifiers, the posted comment, and the comment's secret-put statement with A4 automatic distribution.

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4841.md WI-1. Create apps/mobile/RELEASE.md with sections 'Before you start', 'Operator checklist', 'Secrets the agent requests', 'Build and upload' (left for rel-docs), 'Store facts'. Copy the checklist steps A1-A6, F1-F4, P1-P4, C1, K1 exactly as the PRD lists them (no App Groups; new Firebase project, never mind-your-now). The secrets table names GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON, FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, APNS_KEY_P8, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_TEAM_ID (default KUU2VM9GB9). 'Store facts' states the data list (PRD Fact 16), the export-compliance facts (D-9: X25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305/XChaCha20-Poly1305, SHA-256 via libsodium and Noise; the operator answers), and that App Store submission needs in-app account deletion (H-6). Step A4 also turns on 'Enable automatic distribution' for the 'Operator' internal group, so processed builds reach the operator's iPhone. Then post the checklist and secrets table as a PAN-4841 comment with gh issue comment 4841. The comment states in one sentence, before any secret request: 'The agent will run wrangler secret put for the five push secrets on overdeck-connect and will never run wrangler deploy.'

items.title: Given the committed apps/mobile/RELEASE.md, when grep counts lines starting with the step ids A1-A6, F1-F4, P1-P4, C1 and K1, then it returns 16.

Given RELEASE.md, when a reviewer reads the 'Secrets the agent requests' table, then it names exactly GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON, FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, APNS_KEY_P8, APNS_KEY_ID and APNS_TEAM_ID and contains no secret value.

Given checklist step A1, when a reviewer reads it, then it registers ai.overdeck.app with Push Notifications plus ai.overdeck.app.NotificationService and ai.overdeck.app.widgets and mentions no App Group.
Given the PAN-4841 issue, when gh issue view 4841 --comments runs, then it shows a comment containing the heading 'Operator checklist'.

Given the posted PAN-4841 comment, when read, then it states that the agent will run wrangler secret put for the five push secrets and never wrangler deploy, and step A4 turns on automatic distribution for the 'Operator' TestFlight group.

Generate the Android upload keystore outside the repo and commit its certificate SHA-1 pin

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 and D-2. If ~/.overdeck/secrets/android-upload.jks exists, never overwrite it. Otherwise: mkdir -p ~/.overdeck/secrets, chmod 700; (umask 077; openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -d '\n' > ~/.overdeck/secrets/android-upload.password); keytool -genkeypair -storetype PKCS12 -keystore ~/.overdeck/secrets/android-upload.jks -alias overdeck-upload -keyalg RSA -keysize 4096 -validity 10000 -dname 'CN=Overdeck Upload, O=Overdeck' -storepass:file <pw> -keypass:file <pw>; chmod 600 the keystore. Never print the password. Write the SHA-1 from keytool -list -v (awk '/SHA1:/{print $2; exit}') to apps/mobile/android/upload-certificate.sha1 and commit only that file.

items.title: Given the item is done, when stat runs on ~/.overdeck/secrets and its two files, then it returns modes 700, 600 and 600.

Given the committed apps/mobile/android/upload-certificate.sha1, when compared with keytool -list -v of the keystore, then the SHA-1 matches and the file holds exactly one colon-separated 20-byte uppercase hex line.
Given the repository, when git ls-files is searched for .jks files or android-upload.password, then it returns no match.
Add apps/mobile/scripts/build-android.sh that builds, signs and verifies the release AAB

expected_outputs: no-flag run prints usage and exit=2
missing-keystore run names /nonexistent and prints exit=1

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Bash, set -euo pipefail, mode 755. Flags: --build <n> (required positive integer, else usage and exit 2), --version-name (default 1.0), --keystore (default $HOME/.overdeck/secrets/android-upload.jks), --password-file (default $HOME/.overdeck/secrets/android-upload.password), --alias (default overdeck-upload). cd to repo root. Refuse with exit 1 naming the path, in this order: keystore, password file, apps/mobile/android/upload-certificate.sha1, apps/mobile/android/app/google-services.json. Default JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; write sdk.dir to apps/mobile/android/local.properties. npm --prefix apps/mobile run build; npm --prefix apps/mobile run cap:sync -- android. Export OVERDECK_UPLOAD_* (passwords read with $(<file), never in argv), run ./gradlew --no-daemon bundleRelease -PoverdeckVersionCode=<n> -PoverdeckVersionName=<x>. Then jarsigner -verify, compare keytool -printcert -jarfile SHA-1 with the pin file (exit 1 printing both on mismatch), copy to apps/mobile/release/overdeck-<x>-<n>.aab and print the path and SHA-1. The first real run happens in rel-first-android-release.

items.title: Given no flags, when the script runs, then it prints usage and exits 2.
Given --keystore /nonexistent, when the script runs, then it exits 1 and its message names /nonexistent before any build step starts.

Given the script source, when a reviewer reads it, then no password value is placed in a command argument: passwords reach Gradle only through exported OVERDECK_UPLOAD_* variables read from the password file.
Given a built bundle whose signer SHA-1 differs from apps/mobile/android/upload-certificate.sha1, when the verification step runs, then the script exits 1 and prints the expected and actual SHA-1.

Set the five push secrets on overdeck-connect with wrangler secret put and confirm healthz

verify_commands: cd services/connect && npx --no-install wrangler secret list
expected_outputs: healthz JSON has configured, turn, apns and fcm all true
secret list includes APNS_KEY_P8, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_TEAM_ID, FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, FCM_PROJECT_ID
metadata.acJustification: Five ACs: the healthz result, the secret list, the no-leak/no-deploy rule, the project-id mismatch stop, and the durable record.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-10, D-3, D-4, D-5. No repo files change. Preflight: npx --no-install wrangler secret list in services/connect exits 0 (else comment on PAN-4841 asking the operator to run npx wrangler login). Request APNS_KEY_P8, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_TEAM_ID (default KUU2VM9GB9) and FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON via request_secret (timeoutMs 3600000, PRD prompts) and secret_wait. Check without printing: P8 contains BEGIN PRIVATE KEY; ids match ^[A-Z0-9]{10}$; the service-account JSON has client_email, private_key and project_id equal to google-services.json project_info.project_id. Run npx --no-install wrangler secret put <NAME> < <file> for each, and pipe the derived project id into wrangler secret put FCM_PROJECT_ID. Never wrangler deploy or rollback; never put a value in argv, chat, a comment or a commit. Confirm healthz, then comment on PAN-4840 (fcm:true) and on PAN-4841 (the healthz body). Record the healthz body and the UTC time under '## PAN-4841 store builds' / '### Directory secrets' in apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md (no secret values).

Document the release flow in RELEASE.md and README.md and the secret-put exception in docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md

verify_commands: grep -c 'Store setup and release builds: PAN-4841' apps/mobile/README.md

narrative.Action: PRD WI-15. RELEASE.md 'Build and upload': both script commands with every flag, output locations (apps/mobile/release/, ~/release-ios/ on the rig), the build-number rule (D-1), the console-session rule and CP-1/CP-2 fixes, the keystore location and backup rule (D-2), and the icon regeneration command. README.md: a two-sentence 'Release' section linking RELEASE.md; in 'What it cannot do yet' replace 'Store setup and release builds: PAN-4841.' with 'App Store review (beyond TestFlight) needs in-app account deletion.'; in 'Keys and secrets' replace 'which PAN-4841 registers with the store setup' with 'registered in checklist step A1 of RELEASE.md'. docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md 'Deploy': add the one exception sentence naming PAN-4841 D-3 (agents may run step 5's wrangler secret put with operator-delivered values; wrangler deploy and rollback stay operator-only); in step 5 replace 'values from W-REL1, PAN-4841' with the RELEASE.md source and the FCM_PROJECT_ID derivation, and add that apns:true means present-and-parses, not delivery-proven. Do not create configuration/phone-app.mdx (PAN-4842).

items.title: Given apps/mobile/RELEASE.md, when a reader follows 'Build and upload', then it shows build-android.sh and build-ios-on-rig.sh with every flag, where outputs land, and the --build numbering rule.
Given apps/mobile/README.md, when grep searches for 'Store setup and release builds: PAN-4841', then it returns 0 matches and a 'Release' section links RELEASE.md.
Given docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md 'Deploy', when read, then it states that agents may run only step 5's wrangler secret put (PAN-4841 D-3) and that wrangler deploy and rollback stay operator-only.
Given the docs changes, when npm run lint runs, then it exits 0.
